activity_id.description: Required intervals.icu activity ID whose stream channels should be listed.

athlete_id.description: Target athlete; defaults to selected athlete in coach mode, or the only athlete otherwise. Format: i12345 or 12345.

distance_window.description: Optional inclusive distance window. Local slicing fetches the complete upstream stream first because no verified upstream window query exists.

include_full.description: When true, include bounded raw upstream stream payloads and samples for available stream channels. Raw samples are otherwise omitted.

keys.description: Optional stream channels to return. Values are canonicalized to snake_case when known; unknown keys are reported in _meta. Keys filter channels only and never opt in to raw samples.

max_points.description: Optional per-channel cap for raw sample arrays. Requires include_full:true; uniformly samples selected indices while preserving first and last samples, and reports sampling provenance.

time_window.description: Optional inclusive elapsed-time window. Local slicing fetches the complete upstream stream first because no verified upstream window query exists.

end.description: Inclusive window end in elapsed seconds.

start.description: Inclusive window start in elapsed seconds.
